For the choirmaster. To the tune of “A Dove on Distant Oaks.” A Miktam of David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, O God, for men are hounding me; all day they press their attack.
Have mercy on me, O God, for man is attempting my destruction; every day he makes cruel attacks against me.
（非利士人在迦特拿住大衛。那時，他作這金詩，交與伶長。調用遠方無聲鴿。）神啊，求你憐憫我，因為人要把我吞了，終日攻擊欺壓我。
My enemies pursue me all day long, for many proudly assail me.
My haters are ever ready to put an end to me; great numbers are lifting themselves up against me.
我的仇敵終日要把我吞了，因逞驕傲攻擊我的人甚多。
When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
In the time of my fear, I will have faith in you.
我懼怕的時候要倚靠你。
In God, whose word I praise— in God I trust. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
In God will I give praise to his word; in God have I put my hope; I will have no fear of what flesh may do to me.
我倚靠神，我要讚美他的話；我倚靠神，必不懼怕。血氣之輩能把我怎麼樣呢？
All day long they twist my words; all their thoughts are on my demise.
Every day they make wrong use of my words; all their thoughts are against me for evil.
他們終日顛倒我的話；他們一切的心思都是要害我。
They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps while they wait to take my life.
They come together, they are waiting in secret places, they take note of my steps, they are waiting for my soul.
他們聚集，埋伏窺探我的腳蹤，等候要害我的命。
In spite of such sin, will they escape? In Your anger, O God, cast down the nations.
By evil-doing they will not get free from punishment. In wrath, O God, let the peoples be made low.
他們豈能因罪孽逃脫嗎？神啊，求你在怒中使眾民墮落！
You have taken account of my wanderings. Put my tears in Your bottle— are they not in Your book?
You have seen my wanderings; put the drops from my eyes into your bottle; are they not in your record?
我幾次流離，你都記數；求你把我眼淚裝在你的皮袋裡。這不都記在你冊子上嗎？
Then my enemies will retreat on the day I cry for help. By this I will know that God is on my side.
When I send up my cry to you, my haters will be turned back; I am certain of this, for God is with me.
我呼求的日子，我的仇敵都要轉身退後。神幫助我，這是我所知道的。
In God, whose word I praise, in the LORD, whose word I praise,
In God will I give praise to his word; in the Lord will I give praise to his word.
我倚靠神，我要讚美他的話；我倚靠耶和華，我要讚美他的話。
in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
In God have I put my hope, I will have no fear of what man may do to me.
我倚靠神，必不懼怕。人能把我怎麼樣呢？
Your vows are upon me, O God; I will render thank offerings to You.
I keep the memory of my debt to you, O God; I will give you the offerings of praise.
神啊，我向你所許的願在我身上；我要將感謝祭獻給你。
For You have delivered my soul from death, and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.
Because you have taken my soul from the power of death; and kept my feet from falling, so that I may be walking before God in the light of life.
因為你救我的命脫離死亡。你豈不是救護我的腳不跌倒、使我在生命光中行在神面前嗎？
